pa.reason_text: Requested product is non-preferred. Submit documentation of trial and failure/intolerance of preferred adalimumab-adaz, or change request to preferred product.

documents.content: Dx: rheumatoid arthritis M06.9, rheumatologist. Prior: methotrexate 20 mg/wk 02/2024-08/2024, inadequate (DAS28 5.4). adalimumab-adaz 40 mg q2w 10/2024-01/2025, discontinued for intolerance (see chart). Request: Humira brand.

11/2024: injection-site reactions with each adalimumab-adaz dose. 01/06/2025: generalized urticaria after 6th dose. Assessment: intolerance to adalimumab-adaz, likely excipient-related; discontinue. 02/2025: started Humira (citrate-free), tolerating well. 08/2026: DAS28 2.6, continue.
